name: Flight Leads
summary: An AI sales dashboard for charter operators, launched July 2, 2026. It matches inbound inbox and aggregator requests to available aircraft, prices them on the operator's own rules, and pre-fills a quote ready to send by email or SMS.
paragraphs: An AI sales dashboard for charter operators, launched July 2, 2026. It matches inbound inbox and aggregator requests to available aircraft, prices them on the operator's own rules, and pre-fills a quote ready to send by email or SMS.
whyItMatters: In charter, the first competitive quote usually wins the trip. If your sales desk is juggling several screens per request, measure your current request-to-quote time first, then trial it on retail requests only.
